title: The Last Train
_todo: Panels 3-5 of the end (docs 6.5): the workshop, the gramophone, the Spire. Voice lines train_outro_03, bell_gramophone_01, train_outro_05 do not exist yet.

panels.shot: The last car's door opens. Inside, a perfect copy of Bell's workshop: warm lamplight, the same bench, every clock stopped at 3:17. Nero growls.

lines.text: Only one man ever corrected my left guard.

panels.shot: Close-up. A brass gramophone horn. The needle drops. A pipe rests on the bench, still smoking cherry tobacco.

lines.speaker: Bell (recording)
lines.text: Hello, Elias. Midnight. The Spire. We'll finish the lesson.

panels.shot: Wide, through the train window: across the valley, the Meridian Spire pierces the storm clouds, its giant clock face lit.

lines.text: Bell was alive. And he had been conducting me the whole time.
